name: Inspection interceptor & egress zoom
summary: Turns the egress monitor from 'what/where/how much' into 'let me look': native /dev/bpf per-flow inspection with an honest coverage verdict (plaintext vs encrypted-metadata-only), a btm-style per-app zoom dashboard with a braille line graph (by PID or by destination), a port-heuristic encryption glyph across the views, and a live-speed fix (nettop -n) that took sampling from ~5s to ~10ms.
updateSource: SDD + swarm execution of the exfil inspection interceptor + zoom dashboard

required.title: Per-flow inspection: native /dev/bpf capture + tier-0/1 coverage verdict
required.summary: `i` on an exfil flow captures it via native /dev/bpf (BIOCSETIF/BIOCSETF, IPv4/IPv6 + TCP framing, link-layer strip, host+TCP kernel filter) and returns an HONEST coverage verdict: plaintext shown masked-until-viewed, or ENCRYPTED reported as metadata-only (size + destination, no payload). Bidirectional, per-direction plaintext gating so an encrypted direction is never shown as text. Engine keeps internal/tui -> model/mark only; root I/O in a main adapter behind the Inspector seam.
evidence: root smoke test (COUNTERSPY_LIVE_CAPTURE=1): loopback TLS SNI + filter-drop proof

required.title: Bidirectional trend: in/out/combined sparklines with legend
required.summary: In-rate collection mirrored across the egress pipeline (per-conn/per-PID/per-app history rings); the TREND column and a contextual legend toggle out / in / combined (`t`) with share-of-peak intensity and green->amber direction coloring.

required.title: btm-style per-app zoom dashboard with a braille line graph
required.summary: `z` blows a group into a four-panel dashboard: a braille LINE graph (Bresenham-interpolated, full-width, one color-matched line per PID or per destination), a selectable PID/destinations table with %-of-group share, destinations, and group metadata. `g` moves focus between the PIDs and destinations boxes (arrow-nav + graph grouping follow the focused box); `i` inspects the selection. Stable plot order (no color flicker); Inspection > Zoom > tree modal precedence.
evidence: go test ./internal/tui/ (plotSeries, transitions, focus, render smoke)

required.title: Encryption glyph across the views
required.summary: A sealed-box glyph (TLS) / open-box glyph (cleartext) / blank (unknown) annotates each flow. In the tree and zoom it is a PORT heuristic (well-known TLS vs cleartext ports; STARTTLS stays unknown); in the inspector it reflects the real captured verdict. Documented in the generated legend + README.

required.title: Live-speed fix + faster cadence
required.summary: Diagnosed by timing the real command: nettop was blocking ~5.03s/sample on reverse-DNS. `nettop -n` returns the same snapshot in ~10ms (endpoints stay IPs, which the parser wants). Sample cadence to ~3Hz (0.3s) and the history ring to 60 samples, so the live view + zoom graph actually update at the tick rate.

required.title: Console restructure + always-show-Monitor
required.summary: Section rules give the exfil and findings views btm-like pane structure; the inspect view is split into title/identity/assessment/content sections and explains WHY an encrypted flow has nothing to view (glyph, not emoji). Removed the hide-Monitor toggle (every tier shown by default); moved the Tab switch-modes hint into the footers; asserted the window title so it stops flipping to 'nettop'.

deferred.title: True 4-tuple flow correlation (local port upstream)
deferred.summary: Capture the LOCAL port in the egress collector and thread it through model.Conn + inspect.Flow so same-remote/different-local-port flows never conflate, and scope the kernel BPF filter on it.
deferred.reason: Scope/dependency: needs new collector data (not a code slip); the current host+remote-port+TCP filter plus userspace correlation covers the common case. Tracked as swarm ticket T-8.

deferred.title: Full TCP segment reassembly
deferred.summary: Sequence tracking + reordering so multi-segment plaintext is reconstructed before the plaintext/encrypted decision, not just first-segment framing.
deferred.reason: Sequencing: the tier-0/1 verdict (SNI / first-segment plaintext / metadata) is correct without it; reassembly is a depth improvement best layered on the working interceptor. Tracked as T-10.

deferred.title: CPU% / Mem% columns in the zoom PID panel
deferred.summary: Add per-PID CPU/mem (ps -axo %cpu,%mem) alongside the network columns in the zoom dashboard.
deferred.reason: Scope: keeps v0.5.0 network-focused and avoids a new collector; revisit only if the PID panel has spare real estate and it proves pertinent in use.

deferred.title: Arbitrary-renamed interpreter symlink evasion
deferred.summary: A symlink under a PATH dir pointing at an Apple-signed interpreter (e.g. /opt/x -> python3) run with an inline flag defeats name-based isTrustedShim detection.
deferred.reason: Wrong layer: closing it needs readlink/stat resolution of argv[0], which is filesystem I/O and breaks the pure-over-bytes persistence parser; belongs in the codesign I/O collector. Attacker also needs write to a PATH dir. Tracked as T-13.

outOfScope.title: TLS decryption / MITM
outOfScope.summary: CounterSpy never decrypts. An encrypted flow is reported as metadata-only by design; injecting a trust anchor to MITM the user's own traffic is a different, hostile-shaped product and explicitly not this release.

workstreams.name: Inspection interceptor & egress zoom
workstreams.summary: From egress observation to per-flow inspection + a btm-style zoom dashboard. Built SDD + swarm (single-writer + adversarial fan-out per checkpoint), with a live-capture RCA (4 native-BPF bugs), a review-driven §6 per-direction content fix, a nettop DNS-latency fix diagnosed from real timing, and a line-graph rework. Decoupling invariant held throughout.
